bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to higher education; appropriating money for the Minnesota P-20 Education Partnership.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$1,060,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Office of Higher Education for the Minnesota P-20 Education Partnership under Minnesota Statutes, section 127A.70. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to higher education; appropriating money for the Minnesota P-20 Education Partnership.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION.

$1,060,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Office of Higher Education for the Minnesota P-20 Education Partnership under Minnesota Statutes, section 127A.70.
additions: $1,060,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Office of Higher Education for the Minnesota P-20 Education Partnership under Minnesota Statutes, section 127A.70.
